description: This file implements the RuntimeManagerHandler class for managing application runtime states, including starting, stopping, suspending, resuming, and handling runtime events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles runtime management operations such as start, stop, suspend, resume, and event notifications for applications within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that receives runtime state change notifications and forwards events to the parent handler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager by querying the runtime manager interface and registering for notifications.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters from runtime manager notifications and releases the runtime manager interface.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime information for a specific application instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts an application with specified parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes up an application from suspended or paused state.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Dispatches runtime events to the registered event handler.
